items.title: Kirk Cousins: Remaining starting quarterback in Week 8
items.text:
Head coach Klint Kubiak said that Cousins will remain the Raiders' starting quarterback heading into Sunday's game against the Jets, Paul Gutierrez of ESPN reports. "There is no controversy," Kubiak said. "He is playing at a very high level."

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Nursing ankle issue, should play Week 8
items.text:
Lions head coach Dan Campbell said that St. Brown tweaked his ankle during Sunday's 20-17 win over the Packers but should be ready to practice Thursday, Richard Silva of The Detroit News reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Could be ready to play vs. Bills
items.text:
Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said that Jackson (ankle) is "in a decent spot" to play Sunday against the Bills, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Alec Pierce: Not ready for practice
items.text:
Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Monday that Pierce (heel) will "most likely not" have his 21-day practice window opened in Week 8, Jake Arthur of Roundtable.io reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ladd McConkey: Spotted practicing Monday
items.text:
McConkey (concussion) was spotted on the field in a no-contact jersey during the Chargers' bonus practice session Monday, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
